en: Color postcard showing a tranquil mountain lake with dense conifer forests and hills. In the foreground a woman and three children sit on rocks fishing. Across the water stands a lakeside pavilion with two red-roofed towers and a boathouse. The back has multi‑language caption identifying the lake, Romanian postal markings, stamp and a handwritten message and address.
